title: Cardiac electrophysiology study
description: An electrophysiology study maps your heart's electrical system to identify the cause of irregular heartbeats. During this outpatient procedure, your doctor threads thin catheters through blood vessels to your heart while monitoring electrical signals on screens. The test typically lasts 1-3 hours and you're sedated for comfort. This detailed electrical map guides treatment decisions, whether medication adjustments, pacemaker placement, or ablation therapy. Most people go home the same day with minimal restrictions.
